Rishi — quick summary from my side after checking the staging Ariba connector and our billing ingestion:

- Required fields for automatic PO reconciliation: PO Number (string), PO Date, Supplier ID (Ariba vendor ID), LineItemNumber (if multi-line), ItemDescription (optional), Quantity, UnitPrice, Currency, TaxAmount (if present).
- Optional but strongly recommended: AccountCode / CostCenter for customers that route charges to internal GL accounts. We can accept empty values but it will create manual match exceptions.
- Our current Ariba payload mapping expects "SupplierID" in the header (ACME will need to confirm their supplier ID). If they post different keys, we can add a transformation rule in the connector (low effort).

I've attached a proposed mapping sheet (Acme_PO_field_mapping.xlsx) and a screenshot of the enrollment form that shows the acceptance checkbox which could be misinterpreted (Ariba_enrollment_snapshot.png).

Two asks for Acme: confirm supplier ID and whether they require us to auto-accept order terms on enrollment. If yes, we need legal sign-off.

I'll be available for a 30-min call at 2pm PT if you want to walk the mapping together.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Redwood Inference

Rishi / Monica — reviewed the MSA redline PDF Janelle sent. High-level notes for Legal:

- Data retention (Section 5): Acme wants retention windows for logs and user data to be contractually limited to 7 years with specific deletion triggers. Our standard is 5 years for audit logs; product can accommodate 7 but needs the retention to be documented in the onboarding config and may add ~5% to log storage costs.
- Audit logs & export (Section 7): we already produce audit exports via our Private and Dedicated offerings. For Hosted customers, we provide limited export; full export requires either Dedicated or a managed export procedure. We should avoid any language that implies automatic full exports on Ariba enrollment — that's an operational risk.

Recommendation: propose a two-track approach in our response to Acme: (1) For enrollment purposes, confirm PO field mapping and acceptance workflow (non-contractual step), and (2) separate the contractual acceptance of MSA redline items and set a timeline for Legal to sign off (we can offer documented procedures for retention/export but make those part of the order form/attachment, not auto-accepted during portal onboarding).

I can draft the legal-friendly wording for the response if you want.

-Karthik
Legal Counsel (contracts)
Redwood Inference
